- There is a second UID "ATU22642807" labeled near "Kundennummer" which is the customer's UID; I selected sender UID as ATU50118607 because it appears with supplier contact and footer.
- No other VAT rates/groups for the entire invoice detected; line items not showing different VAT groups.
- Preserved original decimal formatting (commas) as in the invoice text; will not infer any missing fields.

4) Proceed to produce structured extraction with the fields found above.
